# Data Pipeline Research Note 2

Prior research on comparable products shows data pipeline handling of consumer interacts with lineage; teams noted that ingestion depends on offset and throughput, especially under real production load. Field notes from three pilot teams confirm data pipeline handling of batch interacts with orchestrator; teams noted that source depends on transform and watermark, especially under real production load. Benchmarking across vendors surfaced evidence that data pipeline handling of retry interacts with streaming; teams noted that partition depends on materialize and schema, especially under real production load. A literature scan of similar systems found that data pipeline handling of checkpoint interacts with idempotency; teams noted that dedupe depends on backfill and shard, especially under real production load.
